newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank O/N repo rate 20.13 pct (19.11pct).
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank O/N repo rate 20.13 pct (19.11pct).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Wednesday said the average rate at its one-day securities repurchase tender rose to 20.13 percent, from 19.11 percent in a similar tender on Tuesday.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 3.0 billion crowns, the full fixed amount it had offered in Wednesday's tender. Bids totalled 4.75 billion crowns.
Maximum bid in the tender was 20.70 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 19.80 percent, the NBS added.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 98.23 percent as of Tuesday, after being at 97.75 percent the previous day.
